services.name: Helicopter rides for
services.desc: Lift off to the races with a 30-minute helicopter tour over the historic Saratoga Springs. Enjoy 360-degree aerial views of Saratoga Race Course, Saratoga Lake, and more. Discover the historic Saratoga Springs from the sky in a private helicopter tour over the famous Saratoga Race Course, cultural downtown district, and other sites. Book your time now and we’ll contact you within 24 hours to confirm your date, time, and customize your route. See Saratoga Springs like never before with a private helicopter tour. services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: One of the easiest ways to travel from one point to another is by helicopter. There are no traffic jams, no waiting in line, and no other drivers to deal with. For charter flights, we fly either the Robinson R44 helicopter, which can carry up to three passengers, or the Bell Longranger 206L3 helicopter, which can carry up to 6 passengers. On this page you’ll find a list of common airport transfers and regional charter flight destinations, but the scope of your travel area is not limited to these destinations!
